extraction_settings.authored: Wave 2A: authored by rendering an image with PIL 12.1.1 (JPEG q72, 150 dpi, GaussianBlur 0.4, -0.4deg rotation, seeded noise) and embedding the image in a single-page PDF via PIL's PDF writer; that render was image-only (pdftotext returned 0 chars). RE-RENDER NOTE 2026-10-28 (Wave 2B-2): re-rendered as a single-page text-layer PDF via LibreOffice Writer (txt->pdf; producer LibreOffice 26.2.5.2) because the image-only render had no text layer and the footnote_as_operative cases require mechanically extractable text (verbatim quote verification). Same authored PO (PO-2026-04517), same operative footnote-2 terms (payment 45 days, LD 0.75%/week capped at 10%); raw_ocr.txt, normalized.txt and pages.json regenerated from the re-rendered PDF. See artifacts/SYN-05/ATTRIBUTION.md.
extraction_settings.pages_json_command: pdftotext -f N -l N original.pdf - (one-based page_no; regenerated from the re-rendered text-layer PDF)
extraction_settings.normalization_rules: R1 remove NUL bytes; R2 CRLF and lone CR to LF; R3 U+00A0 and U+2007..U+200B converted to U+0020; R4 ligatures U+FB00-FB06 expanded to component letters; R5 form-feed (U+000C) page markers removed; R6 trailing whitespace stripped per line; R7 runs of 3+ blank lines collapsed to 2; R8 nothing else — no spelling, hyphenation or OCR repair of any kind
